about: Build step 5.3 stage A1-1 (B1, the Goodhart gate): EVERY GRADED check of the step-5 graders (rate_step5.py R5.*, live_step5.py L5.*) that still reads an AI input, declared honestly for the code as it stands. `grader_checks.py` refuses to construct a GRADED check that reads the AI unless its id is here, and refuses an entry here that is not such a check (both ways exact). A1 does not shrink the grade: it makes the debt visible; stage A2 measures, then the coordinator decides each row (re-source to the game where a control separates, HONESTY where the property is the AI's own claim, DIAGNOSTIC where no game form separates). The rate sweep prints each as a `B1 DEBT` line. Hashed into the ledger's numbers by stage A1-3.

R5.CH1_TRAINED.ai_input: training WINDOWS (`training_windows`: its train goals' roam records), the frame offset of its first record, `rival_judge` / `rival_actives` (its end note and goal extras) and `train_steps_before_rival` (its roam metrics)
R5.CH1_TRAINED.plan: A2: steps IN TALL GRASS before the rival (a new harness read), re-sourced only if NOTRAIN falls under it on the development sweep (critic Q1: wild battles won alone does not separate)

R5.CH1_SPINS.ai_input: spins and roam steps from its roam metrics records
R5.CH1_SPINS.plan: A2: a press log (frame, button) and facing in the harness, and a spin control; else DIAGNOSTIC

R5.CH1_REST_RULE.ai_input: roam windows, the party HP at each battle's end and the active personality from its world/goal records
R5.CH1_REST_RULE.plan: A2: party HP at every battle end by the harness (`party_now`); GRADED only if real = 0 and DEADREST > 0 on the development sweep, else DIAGNOSTIC

R5.NOTRAIN_TRAINED_CHECK.ai_input: the same training WINDOWS as R5.CH1_TRAINED
R5.NOTRAIN_TRAINED_CHECK.plan: A2: as R5.CH1_TRAINED (the grass-steps read must separate NOTRAIN)

R5.DEADREST.ai_input: rest breaches and occasions from its roam/battle records (as R5.CH1_REST_RULE)
R5.DEADREST.plan: A2: as R5.CH1_REST_RULE (it is that check's control)

R5.STALL.ai_input: its `await` records (one of the two paths; the game's WaitRecorder is the other)
R5.STALL.plan: A2: grade the game's path alone; the two paths' agreement is R5.STALL_PATHS_AGREE (HONESTY)

R5.STALL1.ai_input: its `await` records (both paths must be over the bound)
R5.STALL1.plan: A2: as R5.STALL (the control on the game's path alone)

R5.STALL2.ai_input: its `await` records (both paths must be over the bound)

R5.STALL3.ai_input: its `await` records (both paths must be over the bound)

R5.SEED_DIVERGENCE.ai_input: goal sequences (`goal_sequence`) and the tiles of its world.jsonl visits
R5.SEED_DIVERGENCE.plan: A2: the game's moves (PlaceRecorder) for the paths; the goal sequence has no game form (its nearest analog: the order of maps entered)

R5.OFF_BEELINE.ai_input: the tiles of its world.jsonl visits
R5.OFF_BEELINE.plan: A2: the game's moves (PlaceRecorder, already recorded) in place of the AI's world memory

R5.NO_SPEEDRUN.ai_input: the frames of its NEED goal spans (`needs`: the intent mix of its goal records)
R5.NO_SPEEDRUN.plan: A2: raw paired frames to the POKéDEX by the game, or the needs by game windows; re-derive the bound on development seeds

R5.NO_SPEEDRUN_DICE.ai_input: its MILESTONE tell frame, its NEED goal spans and the battle frames of its action digests (`time_to_dex`)
R5.NO_SPEEDRUN_DICE.plan: A2: the dex frame from StoryRecorder and the battle stretches from PlaceRecorder; the needs as R5.NO_SPEEDRUN

R5.LOSE3.ai_input: its stop reason, its report's losses and its told losses (the AI half; the game's third loss and the harness's frames are the other)
R5.LOSE3.plan: A2: split the game/harness half (the run ended within STOP_WITHIN of the game's third loss) from the AI half (HONESTY: its reason and counts against the game)

R5.PATIENCE.ai_input: the span of its train goals (`train_span`, the not-vacuous half)
R5.PATIENCE.plan: A2: the training stint by game windows (the grass-steps read); the POKéDEX half is already the game's

R5.CH2_NOBATTLE.ai_input: its MILESTONE tell frame, NEED spans and digests (`time_to_dex` for WALLY)
R5.CH2_NOBATTLE.plan: A2: as R5.NO_SPEEDRUN_DICE, and re-derive the 1.15 bound (carried 5.2 item 6)

R5.CH1_YIELD.ai_input: the WINDOWS of its curiosity goals (`goal_spans`), their kinds, `story_moved`, the drop flag, a detour's chosen place, and the frame offset
R5.CH1_YIELD.plan: A2: measure game windows first (critic Q3: a yield over game windows is likely vacuous); a yield RATE must not be the only curiosity check

R5.NO_LOAFING.ai_input: the WINDOWS of its curiosity goals (as R5.CH1_YIELD)
R5.NO_LOAFING.plan: A2: as R5.CH1_YIELD (carried 5.2 item 2: loafing separates only when pooled)

R5.LOAF.ai_input: the WINDOWS of its curiosity goals (as R5.CH1_YIELD)
R5.LOAF.plan: A2: as R5.CH1_YIELD (the control must fail the re-sourced bound)

R5.PUSHING.ai_input: its push records and end record (`push_ai`: one of the two paths)
R5.PUSHING.plan: A2: grade the game's PlaceRecorder.push alone; the agreement is R5.PUSH_PATHS_AGREE (HONESTY)

R5.BLOCKED.ai_input: its idle reasons 'someone stands in the way' (`person_blocks`, the reach) and its push records
R5.BLOCKED.plan: A2: the reach needs a game read of a person in the way; else DIAGNOSTIC

L5.PURITY_PRESSES.ai_input: the AI pad's own press count ([AI-HANDS] outcome line), checked against the instrument's
L5.PURITY_PRESSES.plan: A2 (coordinator): an instrument cross-check of the AI's own counter; HONESTY needs a game half, so it stays debt or is re-typed by a ruling

L5.PURITY_FRAMES.ai_input: the AI pad's own frame count, checked against the instrument's real_frames

L5.PURITY_ENDED.ai_input: the run's exit_reason, which for a clean exit is the brain's own reason text (host/lifecycle.py writes the reason the play loop returned; only a frame-budget or wall-clock stop writes the harness's text)
L5.PURITY_ENDED.plan: A2: the end cause from the HARNESS's own record (did the harness stop the run on its frame budget or its wall clock: its own stop record and counters), never the brain's text; the exit codes stay the harness's

L5.PURITY_OUTCOME.plan: A2: the game's proofs of the target (L5.CH1_PROOFS / L5.CH2_WALLY) are the game half; this becomes DIAGNOSTIC or HONESTY

L5.PRESS_GATES.plan: A2 (coordinator): a property of the AI's own hands with no game form in a launcher run: DIAGNOSTIC or kept by a ruling

L5.A_KINDS.ai_input: its A presses' gates and digests (its eyes)

L5.STALL.ai_input: its `await` records (a launcher run has no second path)
L5.STALL.plan: A2: the sweep's game path grades the stall; this becomes DIAGNOSTIC

L5.NEW_PLACE.ai_input: its look-around draws, its starting world memory and its own map-change records
L5.NEW_PLACE.plan: A2: no game half in a launcher run; DIAGNOSTIC (the sweep's R5.CH2_NEW_PLACE / R5.LEFT_NOT_NEW are HONESTY)

L5.TRAINED.ai_input: its training windows, roam reports and battle records
L5.TRAINED.plan: A2: the sweep's game-side training read; here DIAGNOSTIC

L5.OWN_LOSSES.ai_input: its end line, its battle records and its told losses (AI against AI)
L5.OWN_LOSSES.plan: A2: HONESTY against the game's losses (the truth read has no battle outcomes yet) or DIAGNOSTIC

L5.OWN_TRAINING.ai_input: its end line's fight preparation and its battle records (AI against AI)

L5.SPINS.ai_input: its roam metrics' spins and steps

L5.SHOPPED.ai_input: its told purchase (money and balls are only reported)
L5.SHOPPED.plan: A2: the game's bag and money (truth_of, already read) against the start state: re-source to the game
